Cross-cutting behaviour
JWT validation against Keycloak; permissions from
scope
,
realm_access.roles
and
resource_access.*.roles
claims.
Middleware blocks users who are PENDING or have not accepted terms
(with an allowlist for the endpoints needed to finish setup).
Request body limit 15 MB; CSV upload limit 10 MB.
Redis-backed rate limiting per bucket.
